hypotheses.lean: S : Type*, [MeasurableSpace S], lam : Measure S (any measure)
hypotheses.rewrite: Riemannian manifold S with its volume measure lambda (the printed setting; Lean >= paper)

hypotheses.lean: F : GenerativeFlow S (Markov kernel policy, finite outflow)
hypotheses.rewrite: 'An EGF is a generative flow' (l.161's definition: Markov kernel, finite non-negative outflow)

hypotheses.lean: policy : IsEGFPolicy F.policy Φ α (α measurable, αⁱ ≥ 0, Σαⁱ = 1, π s = Σ αⁱ(s) δ_{Φᵢ s})
hypotheses.rewrite: pi(s) = Σ αⁱ(s) δ_{Phi_i(s)}, α : S → [0,1]^p measurable with Σ αⁱ = 1

hypotheses.lean: nonsingular : ∀ i, lam.map (Φ i) ≪ lam ∧ lam.map (Φ i).symm ≪ lam
hypotheses.rewrite: (Phi_i)_# lambda ≪ lambda and (Phi_i^{-1})_# lambda ≪ lambda for every i (stated explicitly; automatic for diffeomorphisms and the volume)

hypotheses.lean: ergodic : IsGroupErgodic lam (egfGroup Φ) (every measurable A with h⁻¹'A =ᵐ A for all h in the generated group is null or conull)
hypotheses.rewrite: group generated by the Phi_i ergodic for lambda, lambda(h^{-1}A Δ A)=0 for all h ⇒ lambda(A)=0 or lambda(S∖A)=0

hypotheses.lean: isEGFErgodic_iff_symmDiff: generator form λ(Φᵢ⁻¹A Δ A)=0 ∀i
hypotheses.rewrite: 'That is' sentence in the generator form; equivalent given the nonsingularity field
